3e9baaa77a653dec.description: About the Role The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) is seeking a Collaboration Operations Specialist to implement and operate collaboration solutions and platforms. This contract position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The specialist will ensure these solutions meet the requirements of internal and external business stakeholders, focusing on availability, performance, and security. Role Purpose and Scope This role involves the end-to-end operations lifecycle for IsDB's collaboration solutions and platforms, both on-premise and in the cloud. This includes designing, deploying, administering, operating, monitoring, and supporting systems in line with agreed SLAs and KPIs. Collaboration solutions encompass corporate email, calendar, instant messaging, social networking, audio/video conferencing, telephony, content sharing, document management, task management, file storage, and presence awareness, along with complementary security features. Key Responsibilities Design and implement collaboration solution landscapes based on industry standards, covering deployment, administration, operation, monitoring, and support. Develop and maintain tools, solutions, processes, and procedures to achieve performance targets, security controls, service levels, and operational continuity. Support vendor selection and coordination for the implementation, enhancement, operations, and support of collaboration solutions. Supervise third-party service providers to ensure compliance with SLAs, process adherence, and operational objectives for availability, performance, and security. Oversee the implementation and integration of collaboration components aligned with enterprise and solution architecture. Ensure the development, implementation, maintenance, and review of security roles and profiles for collaboration platforms. Manage the transition from collaboration solution design and deployment to operational and support phases. Establish controls to ensure changes to collaboration platforms follow change management processes, minimizing disruption. Develop and manage quality assurance plans for collaboration platforms. Analyze platform performance and develop action plans for enhancement and tuning to meet SLAs and KPIs. Coordinate with teams to plan, design, implement, and test operational resiliency and disaster recovery configurations. Develop and ensure compliance with backup and recovery strategies for collaboration solutions. Supervise monitoring and troubleshooting of incidents related to collaboration platforms. Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure information security policies are implemented and maintained for collaboration platforms. Support end-to-end procurement of collaboration platforms and services. Update and maintain recommended procedures and standards for collaboration solution operations. Develop and deliver communication and awareness campaigns to encourage adoption and efficient usage of collaboration solutions. Support or lead communication with senior management and stakeholders regarding plans, performance, and incidents. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in collaboration solutions and platform operations. Demonstrated experience in designing, deploying, administering, operating, monitoring, and supporting enterprise-level collaboration platforms. Proficiency in managing solutions both on-premise and in cloud environments. Experience with corporate email, instant messaging, audio/video conferencing, document management, and related security features. Work Type This is a contract position within the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB).

3e3e73e14eaea3c3.description: About the Role eham Group is seeking a Tender & Qualification Specialist to join its Business Development team in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah cities. This full-time role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in tender management, vendor registration, prequalification, client relationship management, and business development, with a focus on the Facility Services, Corporate/Business, and Industrial sectors. Role Purpose and Impact The specialist will be instrumental in expanding eham’s market presence by securing vendor approvals with strategic clients and identifying new business opportunities. This position involves supporting the entire tendering process, from initial qualification through submission and subsequent follow-up, directly contributing to business growth. Key Responsibilities Lead the full Vendor Registration, Prequalification, and Approval process with clients until eham is officially approved. Identify and monitor new tenders, RFQs, RFPs, invitations, and business opportunities via client portals and procurement platforms. Manage registrations and opportunities through platforms such as SAP Ariba, Oracle, and other client procurement systems. Maintain and expand the company’s target client and vendor-registration database. Review tender requirements and coordinate internally to ensure complete and compliant submissions. Prepare and compile technical and commercial tender documentation, prequalification packages, capability statements, project references, company profiles, and formatted CVs. Coordinate the tendering process with relevant internal departments and bidding teams. Liaise directly with clients for tender clarifications, additional requirements, and qualification updates. Follow up on submitted proposals, quotations, and tenders through client portals and direct communication. Prepare daily and periodic reports covering new opportunities, qualification status, active tenders, submissions, and outcomes. Arrange and support meetings with potential and strategic clients. Develop and maintain strong professional relationships with clients, procurement teams, key stakeholders, and decision-makers. Maintain accurate records of awarded, lost, pending, and upcoming opportunities. Support Business Development leadership in converting qualified accounts into sustainable business opportunities. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience. Proven experience within the Facility Services, Industrial, and Corporate/Business sectors. Strong hands-on experience in Tendering, Prequalification, Vendor Registration, Business Development, and Client Relationship Management. Demonstrated ability to successfully complete client qualification and vendor approval processes. Strong knowledge of corporate procurement procedures and electronic tendering platforms. Experience dealing with major corporations, industrial organizations, procurement departments, and key accounts. Required Skills Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and public relations skills. Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with senior decision-makers and key stakeholders. An established professional network across the Facility Services and Industrial sectors is a strong advantage. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously. Strong English communication, business correspondence, reporting, and proposal-writing skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering Jeddah and Makkah. The role operates within the Business Development team of eham Group.

3e762df30183085e.description: About the Role Halliburton is seeking a Service Well Testing - Data Acquisition professional to join their team. This full-time position is based in Al Qatif and Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia. The role involves contributing to one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. Key Responsibilities Perform all phases of rigging up and down service line equipment at work locations, both on and offshore. Provide necessary planning for jobs, including equipment setup, well site direction, and customer support activities. Manage activities related to maintaining, setting up, testing, and operating equipment at customer locations and field camps. Mentor and train lower-level Service Operators and Operator Assistants in areas of expertise. Monitor instruments and perform calculations to ensure data quality at the well site. Consult with customers regarding services and products, promote positive customer relations at the well site, and ensure customer satisfaction. Verify equipment as per the job plan, maintain equipment properly, and complete all job documentation. Conduct pre-job toolbox safety meetings, review and verify job plans with customer representatives, and manage any required changes. Lead defined field activities or a shift under the direction of a UBD Supervisor or UBD Well site service leader. Maintain accurate operational records and promptly report deviations or equipment issues. Demonstrate readiness to progress into a full MPD/UBD supervisor role after further leadership exposure. Required Qualifications and Skills Practical MPD/UBD field operations experience. Experience supporting or acting for a supervisor during routine operations. Competence in equipment rig-up, pressure testing, operation, inspection, basic maintenance, and rig-down. Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations. 3e819c03a281237c.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Cost Control Engineer to join their team in Saudi Arabia. Preparing and presenting reports with clear and effective English communication skills. Demonstrated hands-on experience with Primavera P6. Proficiency in English communication and reporting. Prior experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC region is preferred. Experience in Shutdown & Turnaround projects is highly preferred. Additional certification in Cost Control, Project Controls, or Quantity Surveying is an advantage. Work Location This position is based in Saudi Arabia, with potential work locations including Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Ras Tannurah, Al Khafji, Buqayq, and Hafar Al Batin. Application Requirements Candidates must possess relevant experience that directly aligns with the requirements of this Cost Control Engineer position.

Conduct or commission market research to support marketing plans and provide accurate information to management. Set, analyze, and revise product contribution margins, and analyze marketing budgets and sales parameters. Develop and monitor relevant marketing metrics using CRM/ERP technologies to measure progress against objectives. Set pricing strategies and policies to achieve business objectives, support sales growth, and maximize return on investment. Understand product development methodology, conduct consumer research, and evaluate products through different development phases. Prepare and manage strategic marketing plans and brand development plans, contributing to the overall business strategy. 3e61a8da9e898520.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مطعم الاكل الراقي لتقديم الوجبات عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير المعلومات اللازمة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات دقيقة وشاملة للعملاء حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بشكل دوري، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات بما يتوافق مع سياسة الشركة المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة الدفع المختلفة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل مع العملاء وتقديم المعلومات بوضوح. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات خدمة العملاء الممتازة. القدرة على إدارة المخزون وتنظيم المتجر. التعامل الفعال مع عمليات الدفع والمرتجعات. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة حائل، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تقديم أفضل خدمة للعملاء في قطاع المطاعم. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية.

3ebcd50e229161d4.description: About the Role REEF Group is seeking a CRM Specialist to join its Marketing Department in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on developing and executing customer relationship management initiatives across the Group’s brands and channels. The specialist will manage customer data, segmentation, targeted communications, and CRM campaigns to enhance engagement, repeat purchases, and long-term customer value. Key Responsibilities Support the planning and execution of CRM campaigns across various customer communication channels. Manage customer segmentation based on behavior, purchase history, preferences, demographics, and engagement. Develop targeted customer communications for different segments and lifecycle stages. Support customer retention, loyalty, reactivation, and repeat-purchase initiatives. Manage and maintain customer databases, ensuring data accuracy and quality. Monitor customer journeys and identify opportunities to improve engagement and conversion. Coordinate CRM campaigns through SMS, email, push notifications, WhatsApp, and other relevant channels. Track campaign performance, customer response, conversion, retention, and engagement metrics. Analyze customer behavior and purchasing patterns to generate actionable insights. Support loyalty program activities, member engagement, and customer rewards initiatives. Conduct customer segmentation and audience targeting for marketing campaigns and product launches. Collaborate with Marketing, E-commerce, Digital, Retail Operations, Customer Experience, and Data teams. Support campaign testing, including audience, offer, messaging, and timing optimization. Prepare CRM performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations. Monitor inactive customers and develop reactivation campaigns. Support personalization initiatives across different customer touchpoints. Ensure CRM communications align with brand tone, campaign objectives, and customer preferences. Support continuous improvement of CRM processes, customer data utilization, and marketing automation. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in CRM platforms, customer segmentation, campaign execution, customer analytics, and lifecycle marketing. Experience within a retail or consumer-focused environment is required. Demonstrated ability to manage customer data and execute targeted communications. Strong analytical skills to track performance and generate insights. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time basis. The CRM Specialist will work within the Marketing Department, collaborating with various internal teams across REEF Group’s brands and channels. About REEF Group REEF Group is undergoing a period of regional and international growth. As a CRM Specialist, you will contribute to strengthening customer relationships, improving retention and engagement, and building data-driven customer experiences across the Group’s portfolio.

3ef14316884d9ff4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة وليد محمد غزاوي عن صيدلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان صرف الأدوية بدقة وتقديم الإرشاد اللازم للمرضى، مع الالتزام بالمعايير الصيدلانية وإجراءات السلامة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والمواد الصيدلانية، وتحضيرها وصرفها وفقاً للوصفات الطبية. تحديد الآثار الجانبية المحتملة لاستخدام الأدوية وتأثيراتها على الإنسان. تقييم احتياجات الصيدلية من الأدوية والعلاجات، وتحديد أنواعها وكمياتها ومواصفاتها. إعداد وتدقيق طلبات الشراء، ومتابعة توفير الأدوية واستلامها وتخزينها حسب سجلات الموجودات والمعايير الصيدلانية. مراجعة الوصفات الطبية وتجهيز الدواء قبل صرفه، وتقديم الإرشاد للمريض حول طريقة الاستعمال والآثار الجانبية المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال الصيدلة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالصيدلة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الصيدلة. القدرة على فهم وتحليل الوصفات الطبية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية وآثارها. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الإرشاد للمرضى. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية والصيدلانية. القدرة على تنظيم العمل وإدارة المخزون بفعالية. الرغبة في التعلم المستمر ومواكبة التطورات في المجال. بيئة العمل يعمل الصيدلي بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة وليد محمد غزاوي في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لضمان جودة الخدمات الصيدلانية. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الموقع: مكة المكرمة. الراتب: غير معلن.

3e0a2863de3dbd52.description: About the Role Bonn Medical Industries is seeking a Field Marketing Representative to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on executing marketing plans and promotional activities within the market to enhance the company's product presence at various sales points. Role Overview The ideal candidate will possess practical experience in field marketing and trade marketing, capable of translating strategic marketing plans into actionable initiatives. These initiatives will aim to improve product visibility and distribution within stores, pharmacies, and targeted sales outlets in the Western Region. Responsibilities Execute field marketing plans and promotional activities at client locations and points of sale. Conduct regular visits to cosmetics stores, pharmacies, and targeted sales outlets. Monitor the implementation of promotional offers and marketing campaigns within stores. Coordinate with clients to optimize product display locations and increase shelf visibility. Oversee the installation and distribution of promotional materials (POSM) such as stands, posters, and other collateral at points of sale. Coordinate with the sales team to ensure effective execution and achievement of marketing activity objectives. Monitor product availability, pricing clarity, and offers at points of sale, reporting observations to relevant teams. Track the completion of marketing tasks, ensuring they are accomplished according to plan and schedule. Experience in cosmetics, personal care, or Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) is preferred. Strong knowledge of sales points and distribution channels in the Western Region. Excellent communication, negotiation, and client relationship-building skills. Ability to organize field visits, execute plans, and follow up on details. Proficiency in preparing visit reports and documenting field activities. Must currently reside in Saudi Arabia. Willingness to undertake field work and travel within the Western Region. A valid driving license and personal vehicle are preferred. Join the Bonn team and contribute to strengthening our product presence in the Saudi market.

3e32614c851c087e.description: About the Role Albaik Food Systems Co. is seeking a Corporate Engineering Manager to lead its Corporate Engineering Department. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves overseeing Design & Projects, Maintenance, and Engineering Safety functions. The role requires a strategic engineering leader with extensive experience in design, innovation, systems development, and complex problem-solving, coupled with an understanding of international QSR trends and emerging technologies. Key Responsibilities Develop and continuously improve corporate engineering systems, standards, manuals, policies, and processes. Lead innovative restaurant design solutions, kitchen layouts, and engineering developments to enhance operational efficiency, capacity, and customer experience. Establish engineering training programs, technical competency frameworks, and capability development initiatives for regional engineering teams and licensees. Develop and oversee engineering compliance audits, performance evaluations, and corrective action systems. Provide technical leadership in resolving complex engineering challenges and conflicts related to standards and processes. Drive engineering research, innovation, and continuous improvement through international benchmarking and emerging technologies. Lead and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary corporate engineering team. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Architecture. More than 10 years of progressive engineering experience, including at least 5 years in leadership positions. Proven expertise in engineering design, innovation, project management, and technical systems development. 3e4fba5879dab14a.description: About the Role Namaa Partners is seeking an HR Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, remote position responsible for managing human resources processes within the Kingdom. The role involves supporting organizational and leadership work for corporate groups across Saudi Arabia, with a focus on HR administration and data preparation for client reviews. Key Responsibilities Post job openings, screen applications based on agreed criteria, and schedule interviews with hiring principals. Prepare offer letters and employment contracts, and manage the onboarding process for new employees in Saudi Arabia. Maintain accurate employee files, leave records, and generate monthly HR reports. Communicate payroll changes to the payroll provider and ensure GOSI and Qiwa records are current. Collect job descriptions, grades, and headcount figures from client teams for organizational reviews. 3e15e1a7434bb412.description: About the Role BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is seeking an Egress Senior Supervisor to join their team in Taif. This full-time role is integral to supporting the Salam Project, ensuring its success against contracted Operational Readiness (OR) and Key Performance Measurements (KPM) for Maintenance Support Services. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience and offers a competitive salary. Company Context BAE Systems operates as the UK Government’s nominated Prime Contractor, providing equipment, support, and training to Saudi Arabia under Government-to-Government arrangements. The company is responsible for the maintenance of Royal Saudi Air Force (RSAF) aircraft and the training of RSAF and Royal Saudi Naval Force personnel. BAE Systems Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting the Saudi Arabian National Agenda, including Saudisation and the development of Saudi National capabilities through partnerships and industrialisation. Key Responsibilities Report to the Primary Line Manager with direct access to a Secondary Line Manager for independent issue resolution within the Egress Shop maintenance environment. Review maintenance practices, challenge existing methods, and identify potential improvements within the organisation. Identify and report any malpractice affecting the airworthiness or safety of assigned components or personnel to the Senior Maintenance Manager. Manage and ensure the availability of necessary manpower and facilities resources in accordance with company policies and contractual obligations. Oversee the development reports for all direct and indirect line management personnel within the area of responsibility. Provide consolidation and counterpart development activities for RSAF and BAE Systems personnel. Ensure all tasks are completed within designated timeframes to support Forward Maintenance and SMU activities. Manage the operational readiness of shop equipment, including necessary calibrations, correct tooling, and approved data. Report deficiencies in approved data using appropriate media. Report and monitor any damage or deficiencies to equipment and infrastructure using specified media (*, IDR, MDR, CAR, SORT, 1400-61). Maintain anti-FOD surveillance and report potential hazards, enhanced by regular oversight checks of the shop and its components. Ensure all maintenance tasks meet the highest quality standards, including accurate recording on the airworthiness tool (ESS) for work carried out, test results, consumables, and POL. Support knowledge transfer and skill development among team members, maintaining training records and logs. Manage the TTP131 spreadsheet to reflect forecasted planning and highlight any deficiencies or delivery issues with consumables and PPE. 3e32b4d7d2c9e4dd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تهاتن للخدمات البيئية عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى استقطاب عملاء جدد لخدمات الشركة في مجال إدارة النفايات ونقلها والتخلص منها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تطورات السوق وتحديد الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع، وتقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل مع العملاء لتحديد احتياجاتهم ومشكلاتهم، ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية. تقييم أداء مندوبي المبيعات ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الإجراءات التصحيحية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات وتقديم التوصيات. مسؤوليات تطوير الأعمال استقطاب عملاء صناعيين وتجاريين وحكوميين جدد لخدمات جمع النفايات ونقلها والتخلص منها. تحديد العملاء المحتملين والتواصل معهم لتقديم خدمات إدارة ونقل النفايات الخطرة وغير الخطرة. زيارة العملاء المحتملين لفهم أنواع النفايات لديهم واحتياجاتهم، وعرض الخدمات المناسبة. جمع بيانات النفايات وكمياتها ومواقع العملاء، ورفع طلبات التسعير إلى مدير المبيعات. متابعة المنافسات وطلبات تقديم عروض الأسعار، بما في ذلك المنافسات الحكومية عبر منصة اعتماد. متابعة عروض الأسعار حتى توقيع العقد، ثم تسليم العميل لإدارة العمليات. تحديث قاعدة بيانات العملاء المحتملين وسجل الزيارات، وإعداد تقارير أسبوعية بالأنشطة والإنجازات. جمع وتحليل معلومات السوق والمنافسين ورفع التقارير ذات الصلة إلى الإدارة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على وضع الخطط البيعية وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. مهارات تواصل قوية وبناء علاقات مع العملاء. القدرة على تحليل السوق والمنافسين. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي، مع التركيز على توسيع قاعدة عملاء الشركة في قطاعات مختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

You will combine technical expertise with client advisory, supporting projects from early feasibility studies through to implementation. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams and a global network of specialists, you will help clients improve supply chains and address increasingly complex operational, sustainability, and investment challenges. Solid understanding of CAPEX, project execution strategies, and investment decision-making processes. Strong stakeholder management and client-facing skills. And with voluntary social and sports activities, and employee networks such as Pride and Young Haskoning. 3e716eec7689574c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مدير مراجعة داخلية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للمراجعة الداخلية، وضمان التزام الموظفين بالأنظمة واللوائح، والتحقق من كفاءة الإجراءات لحماية أصول الجهة وممتلكاتها. كما يقدم شاغل الوظيفة المشورة للإدارة في المواضيع المتعلقة بعمل المراجعة الداخلية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة عمليات فحص التقارير والمستندات والسجلات المالية والحسابات الختامية والعقود والاتفاقيات المبرمة، للتأكد من صحتها ونظاميتها. تحديد مواطن الخلل وسوء الاستخدام المحتملة ضمن العمليات والإجراءات. ضمان فعالية ودقة أنشطة تنظيم وحفظ الوثائق الخاصة بعمليات المراجعة الداخلية، بما يضمن سهولة استرجاعها والاستفادة منها عند الحاجة. إعداد خطط التدقيق التي تهدف إلى التأكد من التزام موظفي الجهة بالأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات والإجراءات المعمول بها. التحقق من كفاءة وملاءمة الأنظمة والإجراءات لضمان حماية أصول الجهة وممتلكاتها من الاختلاس أو الضياع أو التلاعب. تقديم المشورة المتخصصة للإدارة العليا في جميع المواضيع ذات العلاقة بعمل المراجعة الداخلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المراجعة الداخلية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تطوير أهداف المراجعة الداخلية وإعداد خطط التدقيق. فهم عميق للأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات والإجراءات المتعلقة بالعمليات المالية والإدارية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب العمل الالتزام الكامل بمهام المراجعة الداخلية لضمان أعلى مستويات النزاهة والفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة معين للموارد البشرية.

Conduct daily site inspections to ensure MEP installation complies with approved shop drawings, specifications, approved materials and method statements . Identify defective/non-compliant work and issue or coordinate NCRs, observations and corrective-action reports . Follow up NCRs and consultant comments until 100% closure . Coordinate with MEP engineers, supervisors and subcontractors to rectify quality issues before consultant inspection. Verify that only approved materials are delivered and installed on site and check material certificates, datasheets, test certificates and approvals. Inspect HVAC works including ductwork, insulation, chilled water/refrigerant piping, FCUs/AHUs, diffusers, dampers and equipment installation . Inspect electrical works including containment, conduits, cable trays, wiring, DBs, panels, lighting, power, earthing and associated systems . Inspect plumbing and drainage works including water supply, drainage piping, pressure testing, slopes, supports, insulation and fixtures . Inspect firefighting and fire alarm installations and coordinate required inspections and testing. Ensure proper MEP coordination above ceilings and within walls before closing ceilings, partitions or access panels , particularly important on high-end fit-out projects. Verify MEP interfaces with architectural finishes, joinery, ceilings, lighting, specialist systems and FF&E to prevent damage and rework. Witness and document pressure tests, insulation resistance tests, continuity tests, duct leakage tests, flushing, testing & balancing and other required MEP tests . Coordinate and maintain complete Testing & Commissioning (T&C) documentation , test sheets and certificates. Monitor calibration certificates for testing instruments and ensure only calibrated equipment is used. Carry out pre-inspections before raising inspections to the consultant to minimize rejection rates. Monitor workmanship quality and ensure installations meet the required high-end fit-out finish standards . Prepare snag/punch lists , coordinate rectification and obtain consultant/client closure. As a DBA Trainee, you will gain hands-on exposure to production-scale database environments and learn how databases are designed, monitored, optimized, secured, backed up, and recovered. Therefore, we are looking for someone who approaches tasks carefully, validates their work, asks the right questions, and remains calm when investigating technical problems. This will be a challenging learning journey filled with technical exploration, troubleshooting, benchmarking, automation, and real-world engineering experience. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives across the Data Platform. The ideal candidate should have: Good foundational knowledge of SQL. The ability to write queries using joins, aggregations, filtering, and subqueries. Basic Python programming skills. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities. An analytical mindset and close attention to detail. The ability to compare results, benchmark solutions, and validate assumptions. A willingness to investigate problems instead of accepting results at face value. Good communication and documentation skills. A strong desire to learn database technologies and production engineering practices. Preferred Knowledge The following experience is beneficial but not mandatory: Familiarity with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, or similar database technologies. Basic knowledge of Linux and command-line tools. Understanding of database indexes, transactions, schemas, and data types. Exposure to Git, APIs, cloud platforms, or container technologies. Experience working on academic, personal, or graduation projects involving data or automation. What You Will Learn During the program, you will have the opportunity to learn: How enterprise databases operate at scale. Database performance tuning and query optimization. Safe change-management practices for production environments. How to think and operate like a Database Reliability Engineer. Who Will Succeed in This Role? Want to build a career in databases, cloud data platforms, or reliability engineering. Our Commitment to You You will not be expected to know everything from day one. You will receive guidance, practical experience, and opportunities to work with experienced engineers. At the same time, we will challenge you to think critically, research independently, test your ideas, and gradually take ownership of meaningful technical tasks. This is more than a training opportunity. It is an adventure into the world of databases, where reliability, accuracy, automation, and engineering discipline come together to support systems used at scale.
